did.unittitle: Laurance S. Rockefeller General Files (Room 5600), 1997-2000, RG 48

physdesc.extent: 133 boxes including 130 letter document boxes, 1 record storage box, 1 legal document box, and 1 half-letter document box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access note
accessrestrict.p: Open for research in accordance with the terms of donation of the Laurance S. Rockefeller estate.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The general files primarily consist of correspondence, reports, pamphlets, memoranda, charters and certificates of incorporation, minutes and meeting records as well as documentation of contributions, finance and investment materials, real estate, newspaper clippings, diaries, notebooks, calendars, audio and video tapes, and printed material.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: These records were created and maintained by and at Room 5600, the Rockefeller family office.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order. Alphabetically arranged in 41 series primarily by subject/topic.
